name: tooltip-card

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the full Quick tip panel open beside its button, clear of the cursor.

tagline: Follows the cursor with a dark hint panel that springs open beside it.
summary: Attaches a tooltip to any element. Hovering or tapping shows a small dark panel with a title and text near the pointer; it springs open, flips at screen edges and closes on leave.
appearance: Two small outlined buttons, "Hover me" and "Or hover me", sit on a near-black stage under a line of grey caption text. A hover reveals a dark rounded panel with a bold heading and a few lines of grey text floating next to the cursor, or a single short line in the string variant.
behaviour: Entering a button springs the panel open from zero height close to the pointer, and it follows the cursor while open. Near a viewport edge it jumps to the other side, and it collapses when the pointer leaves or after a touch tap.
demo_content: "Hover me" and "Or hover me" buttons; a "Quick tip" card and a one-line string tooltip.
search_phrases: tooltip that flips near screen edge
hover popup with a title and text
tooltip on both mouse and touch
use_when: A short hint, definition or preview should appear right at the pointer without shifting the page.
avoid_when: The panel opens from pointer events only, so keyboard and screen-reader users never reach it.
customise: The panel body is a content prop, string or markup, and the trigger is passed as children; width, colours and padding live in the source.
weight_why: A single panel mounts on hover; no animation loop and no canvas.

a11y.note: The trigger has no focus or keyboard handlers and the panel is not tied to it with aria-describedby, so assistive tech misses it.

issues: Nothing links the tooltip to its trigger for keyboard or screen-reader users.
The panel assumes a 240px width, so wider content can run past the viewport edge.
polish_why: Soft spring and tidy dark panel; the opening panel briefly overlaps its trigger.
